articles.title: Trump eyes Pentagon leadership changes as frustration over Iran war grows: Report
articles.summary: In light of ongoing leadership transitions within the Army, several candidates have emerged as potential successors to the former US Army Secretary. President Trump has been appraised of various options amidst growing tensions from the Iran conflict, though White House and Pentagon sources have refuted rumors regarding a review of the Deputy Secretary of War role.

articles.title: US warns of rising illnesses in Cuba amid worsening water, power crisis; embassy issues health alert
articles.summary: The US Embassy in Havana has raised alarms about rising intestinal illnesses in Cuba, attributing them to the deteriorating water and electricity systems on the island. Ongoing restrictions on fuel shipments from the US have intensified these power outages and sanitation issues.

articles.title: US man duct-taped to seat after attacking passenger mid-flight, racial abuse
articles.summary: An American Airlines flight traveling from Dallas to Newark had to make an unexpected stop in Baltimore due to a disruptive passenger. The individual reportedly attacked another traveler and directed racial insults toward a flight attendant.

articles.summary: Mirzapur: The Movie has achieved a significant opening day collection of Rs 24.75 crore net. This impressive debut places it as the fourth-highest opening day grosser for Hindi films in 2026.

articles.summary: Actress Sreeleela showcased a nostalgic Bharatanatyam performance from her childhood in celebration of Krishna Ashtami. Her passion for classical dance has been evident since her formative years.

articles.title: Dolly Parton’s sister talks about how the family is dealing with everything
articles.summary: Stella Parton has opened up about the profound grief her family is experiencing after the loss of Dolly Parton. She expressed her heartfelt appreciation for the support from close friends and family while highlighting the often harsh and thoughtless comments from outsiders.

articles.title: Chiranjeevi’s ‘Kaaka’ to begin new Hyderabad schedule soon
